strings.book_help_animal: Select this animal to inspect its stats, traits and recorded ancestry.
strings.book_help_previous: Browse the previous page of nearby tame animals.
strings.book_help_next: Browse the next page of nearby tame animals.
strings.book_help_close: Close the herd book and return to the game.
strings.piece_trough_description: Hungry tamed animals, and animals being tamed, come to eat the food you put in it.
strings.lore_taming_gate: Needs a Husbandry {0} keeper within {1} m to tame
strings.lore_taming: Tamed in about {0} while fed and calm
strings.book_rename_reach: Come within 5 m of the animal to rename it.
strings.book_empty_hint: Feed a boar, wolf or lox to start a herd
strings.piece_land_pen_description: A fenced enclosure with a gate. Pen Mode uses this pen's herd limit.
strings.step_aside_feeding: Feeding is off while {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_husbandry: Husbandry is off while {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_inheritance: Offspring inheritance is off while {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_containers: Container feeding is off while {0} is installed.
strings.import_done: Imported {0} settings from {1}. The original files are unchanged.
strings.command_busy: A breeding command is still pending.
strings.command_target: Look at a living tamed animal within reach.
strings.command_unknown: Outcome unknown; inspect the animal before retrying.
strings.feed_mark_busy: A feed-source change is still pending.
strings.feed_mark_unknown: Outcome unknown; inspect the container before retrying.
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Enables Shepherd. Saved Husbandry levels and lineage are kept when off.
strings.cfg_1_general__feeding_enabled_help: Enables trough and optional container feeding.
strings.cfg_1_general__breeding_enabled_help: Enables inheritance, twins, breeding pace and lineage.
strings.cfg_1_general__herd_enabled_help: Enables Shepherd herd limits and pen policy.
strings.cfg_1_general__husbandry_enabled_help: Turns every Husbandry feature on or off: taming, breeding, yield, companions, the feeder's eating, animal lore and experience. Off, animals behave exactly as in the game. Levels are kept either way.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__require_move_to_feed_help: Animals must approach their food source before eating.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__move_proximity_help: Maximum distance in meters from the source when eating.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__reach_through_walls_help: Maximum combined solid wall thickness in meters when approaching food. 0 requires a clear feeding reach. Floors and terrain block feeding.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__give_up_seconds_help: Seconds before abandoning an unreachable food source.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__feed_wild_animals_help: Untamed tameable animals may eat from troughs to begin taming.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__container_feeding_help: Allows non-private player containers as food sources. Off by default.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__container_selection_help: Use eligible containers except denied ones, or only containers marked as a feed source.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__disallow_feed_help: Comma-separated item prefab names never fed automatically.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__disallow_animals_help: Comma-separated creature prefab names never fed automatically.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__protect_feed_containers_h: Animals cannot damage their eligible troughs and feed containers.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__show_food_on_troughs_help: Display stored food on trough straw.
strings.cfg_2_feeding__trough_range_help: Meters. A hungry tamed animal, or one being tamed, walks to a feeder this close that holds food it eats, and eats one item from it.
strings.cfg_3_troughs__plank_trough_recipe_help: Comma-separated item:amount recipe. Unusable recipes fall back to Wood:10.
strings.cfg_3_troughs__stone_trough_recipe_help: Comma-separated item:amount recipe. Unusable recipes fall back to Wood:10.
strings.cfg_3_troughs__build_level_help: Husbandry level from which a player can build the Animal Feeder (hammer, Misc). 0 lets everyone; above 100 hides it from the hammer. Feeders already built keep working.
strings.cfg_3_troughs__feed_barrel_recipe_help: What the Animal Feeder costs: item prefab names with amounts, comma-separated. Built at a workbench. Unknown items are skipped; an empty or unusable recipe falls back to Wood:10.
strings.cfg_4_husbandry__lore_detail_help: Compact gives one lore line; Full gives every available detail.
strings.cfg_4_husbandry__keeper_range_help: Meters. An animal is tended by the best Husbandry level among the players this close to it: that level drives its fed time, breeding, twins, better offspring, growth and produce, and players this close earn experience from it. Taming speed uses the game's own taming range (60 m) instead.
strings.cfg_4_husbandry__animal_lore_level_help: Husbandry level from which hovering an animal or an egg shows its timers: fed time left, taming time left, love and pregnancy, herd room, contentment, growing up and hatching. 0 gives it to everyone; above 100 turns it off.
strings.cfg_4_husbandry__show_callouts_help: Shows words like Twins! and Strong offspring! floating above animals near you.
strings.cfg_5_taming__taming_speed_at_100_help: Percent faster taming with a level 100 keeper within the creature's taming range (the game's 60 m). 100 tames in half the time. It stacks with the game's own taming boost.
strings.cfg_5_taming__fed_duration_at_100_help: Percent longer an animal stays fed after eating, with a level 100 keeper within Keeper Range when it eats. 100 doubles it (the game's 10 minutes become 20). Animals breed, heal and tame only while fed.
strings.cfg_5_taming__taming_levels_help: Creatures that need a keeper of some Husbandry level before taming makes progress: creature prefab names with a level, comma-separated, e.g. Lox:30, Asksvin:50, Moose:60. The keeper must stand within the game's taming range (60 m). Empty: anyone tames anything, as in the game.
strings.cfg_5_taming__calm_level_help: Husbandry level from which a creature you have started taming (tameness above 0%) neither flees from nor attacks you, and you no longer frighten it, so taming goes on while you stand beside it. Only you: players below the level still scare it. 0 gives it to everyone; above 100 turns it off.
strings.cfg_5_taming__calm_break_time_help: Seconds a creature stays wary of a calm player after that player hurt it: it defends itself as usual until then.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__star_inheritance_help: How a newborn's base stars are chosen. Vanilla: the mother's stars, as in the game. BestParentUniform: a random number from 0 to the stronger parent's stars. ParentMean: the parents' average, rounded up.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__max_above_best_parent_he: Maximum bonus levels above the stronger parent.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__birth_star_chance_help: Flat percent chance of an additional birth star, independent of Husbandry.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__twin_delay_help: Seconds between the first birth and a twin.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__mutation_chance_help: Percent chance to carry a Wildblood mutation. Used only when Wildblood supplies traits.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__record_lineage_help: Record parent identities, generation, birth day and breeder.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__breeding_speed_at_100_he: Percent faster breeding with a level 100 keeper: pregnancy is shorter and fewer breeding checks are skipped. 100 halves the wait.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__growth_speed_at_100_help: Percent faster growing up for tamed young animals and faster hatching for warm eggs, with a level 100 keeper. 100 halves the time.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__better_offspring_at_100_: Percent chance, with a level 100 keeper, that a newborn or a laid egg is one star above its parent (the game passes the parent's own level on).
strings.cfg_6_breeding__max_offspring_level_help: The highest game level Better Offspring reaches: 1 is no star, 2 one star, 3 two stars (the most the game spawns). Drops double with each level. With Elite Creatures Reborn installed its own breeding decides stars, and Better Offspring gives one star more, up to one above the stronger parent.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__twins_at_100_help: Percent chance, with a level 100 keeper, that a birth is followed by a second one (a second egg for hens) half a minute later. A twin never has twins of its own.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__content_duration_help: Seconds a tamed animal stays content after it is petted. Petting a content animal again earns no experience. 0 turns contentment off.
strings.cfg_6_breeding__content_breeding_bonus_h: Percent faster breeding while an animal is content, on top of Breeding Speed. Any level can pet.
strings.cfg_7_herd__strict_herd_limit_help: Delay a due birth while the herd is over its current limit.
strings.cfg_7_herd__pen_mode_help: Count crowding within an assigned livestock pen. A pen capacity of 0 keeps the game's own crowding limit.
strings.cfg_7_herd__pause_breeding_on_moving_shi: Pause breeding in a moving Keel ship pen.
strings.cfg_7_herd__land_pen_capacity_help: With Pen Mode on, the most animals a land pen holds before breeding stops. 0 keeps the game's own crowding limit.
strings.cfg_7_herd__land_pen_recipe_help: Comma-separated item:amount recipe for the land pen.
strings.cfg_7_herd__herd_size_at_100_help: More animals of a kind (young included) that may stand within the game's crowding range (10 m, 20 m for lox) before breeding stops, with a level 100 keeper. The game allows 4 to 10 by kind.
strings.cfg_8_yield__butcher_yield_at_100_help: Percent more drops from a tamed animal killed by a level 100 player (meat, hides, feathers; never trophies). A fraction is a chance of one more.
strings.cfg_8_yield__honey_per_day_help: Honey each hive produces per native game day. 0 keeps its native rate. Capacity and harvest bonuses are unchanged.
strings.cfg_8_yield__honey_per_player_online_hel: Each hive produces one honey per online player per native game day. Overrides Honey Per Day.
strings.cfg_8_yield__produce_chance_at_100_help: Percent chance, each Produce Interval, that a fed tamed animal with a level 100 keeper near drops one of its own materials without being killed: feathers from hens, leather scraps from boars, pelts from wolves and lox, hides from moose. Meat and trophies never. 0 turns it off.
strings.cfg_8_yield__produce_interval_help: Seconds between an animal's produce rolls.
strings.cfg_8_yield__extra_honey_at_100_help: Percent chance per honey that a level 100 player harvesting a beehive gets one more. 0 turns it off.
strings.cfg_9_companions__pack_damage_at_100_hel: Percent more damage dealt by a tamed creature that follows a level 100 player (wolves, which the game lets you command).
strings.cfg_9_companions__pack_toughness_at_100_: Percent less damage taken by a tamed creature that follows a level 100 player.
strings.cfg_10_experience__taming_experience_hel: Experience for a whole taming's progress (0% to 100%), earned bit by bit while you are near, times the tier.
strings.cfg_10_experience__tamed_experience_help: Experience when a creature near you becomes tame, times the tier.
strings.cfg_10_experience__discovery_multiplier_: The Tamed Experience is multiplied by this for the first creature of each kind a character tames. 1 turns it off.
strings.cfg_10_experience__feeding_experience_he: Experience each time a tamed animal, or one being tamed, eats near you, times the tier.
strings.cfg_10_experience__birth_experience_help: Experience for each birth or laid egg near you, times the tier.
strings.cfg_10_experience__petting_experience_he: Experience for petting a tamed animal that is not content yet, times the tier.
strings.cfg_10_experience__butchering_experience: Experience for killing a tamed animal, times the tier.
strings.cfg_10_experience__honey_experience_help: Experience per honey harvested from a beehive (no tier).
strings.cfg_11_interface__herd_book_key_help: Keyboard chord to open the herd book; unbound by default.
strings.cfg_11_interface__herd_book_pad_chord_he: Gamepad chord to open the herd book; unbound by default.
strings.cfg_11_interface__herd_book_range_help: Herd book search range in meters.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__instant_tame_help: Complete taming after the first meal.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__instant_growth_help: Young grow and warm eggs hatch on the next update.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__breeding_commands_help: Enable shepherd breed and shepherd stars console commands.
